name: Aberford Park Playground and Sensory Play Area
text: A playground for under-8s with a multi-play unit, toddler and flat swings, roundabout and zip wire, plus a sensory play area for up to 12s with a basket swing, rotating dish, rope bridge and climbing wall, next to a skate park, restaurant and toilets.

name: Brook Meadow Play Area
text: Play area for children up to eight on the Tykes Water Greenway, with football pitches and a basketball post.

name: Brookside Play Area
text: Play area with woodland and meadow, on a greenway linking to Swanland Road.

name: Byron Avenue Play Area
text: Play area for children up to eight, rebuilt in 2020 in Robinia wood alongside a street football enclosure.

name: Composers Park Play Area
text: Toddler play area with swings, multi-play units and a roundabout, plus a climbing frame for older children and a kickabout area.

name: Elstree Hill North Play Area
text: Play area for under-eights on the footpath between Elstree Crossroads and Borehamwood station.

name: Farriers Way Open Space Play Area
text: Play area for under-eights with a five-a-side goal and meadow grassland.

name: Kelly Court and Potterswood Park Play Areas
text: Kelly Court Play Area is aimed at children up to 8 with a climbing mound, and Potterswood Park has a play area, kickabout area and picnic tables.

name: Kenilworth Park Play Area
text: Large play area at Kenilworth Park (King George V Playing Fields), with basketball and football.

name: King George Recreation Ground Play Area and Splash Park
text: Inclusive play destination for ages 2 to 12 with a pyramid net, double cableway, multi-units with slides, swings and a wheelchair-accessible roundabout, teen climbing, and a seasonal tropical island splash park, with toilets and a café.

name: King George V Playing Fields Play Areas (Furzefield)
text: Two play areas with a skate park and community shelter at King George V Playing Fields, with free parking off Mutton Lane.

name: Meadow Park Play Areas and Splash Zone
text: Two inclusive space- and earth-themed play areas with an 8m tube slide, trampoline mounds and interactive play, a toddler area, and a seasonal splash zone with jets and water columns.

name: Newcome Road Play Area
text: Play area between Newcome Road and Anderson Road.

name: Oakmere Park Play Areas
text: Fenced toddler play area for under-8s with multi-play, slide, swings and roundabout, plus a junior play area with climbing, a double zip wire and a large slide; toilets and Oakmere House restaurant on site.

name: Organ Hall Open Space Play Area
text: Play area for under-eights next to open grassland with an informal football goal.

name: Parkfields Play Area and Toddlerwood
text: Play area including Toddlerwood and a trampoline, where children can ride the Parkfields Express train from the Toddlerwood station.

name: Ridge Play Area
text: Play area for under-eights.

name: Ripon Park Play Area
text: Fenced play area for children up to 13 with toddler and junior multi-units, swings, rotor dish, see-saw and climbing boulder, plus a zip wire and small BMX-style cycle track outside, beside Three Ways Community Centre.

name: The Glebeland Play Area
text: Village-green-style open space with a play area, basketball post and goal net.

name: The Moatfield Play Area
text: Play area with a zip wire, nest and carousel swings, trampoline, climbing unit, spinning dish, mounds with a bridge and an obstacle course, with railings around the toddler equipment.

name: Willow Way Open Space Play Area
text: Fenced play area for under-eights and challenging play for older children, with a basketball post, football goal and fitness equipment.

name: Windmill Lane Recreation Ground Play Area
text: Children's play area with a basketball court and large oak trees in Bushey Heath.
